name: Camping 101: Skinning
summary: In Tirisfal Glades, Camping 101: Skinning sends new skinners to learn a useful craft. They learn to make a camp chair from harvested hides and where to find teachers across Azeroth.

sections.title: Comfort in the Wilds
sections.body: A sharp blade alone will not carry you through the wilds. You also need a way to rest between trials. In the field, skinners can learn the basics and use treated skins to make a chair for camp. It gives weary travelers a place to recover before danger calls again.

sections.title: Mastering the Craft
sections.body: Young Forsaken skinners in Tirisfal Glades are sent to Rand Rhobart once they reach their first measure of skill. He works along the road between Brill and the Capital ruins of the Undercity. Rhobart teaches practical ways to turn rough leather into a seat for camp. Skinning masters across the lands of the Horde and Alliance teach the same craft.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The lesson sends new skinners to a trade mentor, who teaches them to make a camp chair from harvested animal pelts.

faq.q: Who offers this training in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton gives the lesson in Tirisfal Glades and points new skinners to Rand Rhobart, along the road between Brill and the Undercity.

faq.q: What skill level is required to complete this task?
aliases: what skinning level do i need
faq.answer: You need a skinning skill of at least twenty before a trainer will teach you to make camp equipment.

faq.q: Where can Rand Rhobart be found?
faq.answer: Rand Rhobart works along the main road south from Brill toward the entrance to the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Can members of other factions learn this technique?
faq.answer: Yes. Forsaken learn from Rand Rhobart, while other instructors teach skinners in Goldshire, Ironforge, Dolanaar, Orgrimmar, Bloodhoof Village, and Shen'dar Village.

faq.q: Why is crafting a camp chair useful?
aliases: what does a camp chair do
faq.answer: A camp chair gives you a comfortable place to sit and regain your strength in the wilds. Rest there, and you can stay alert for the battles ahead.

angles.text: As an Undead, you may be free from mortal exhaustion, but a working camp is still useful while you hunt the plagued beasts of Tirisfal.
As a member of the Horde, you can use every part of a slain beast and leave nothing to waste along the hard road.
